name: affine-connector
description: AFFiNE connector for ChatGPT with dynamic native MCP passthrough and optional server-side API access.

interface.shortDescription: Use the native AFFiNE workspace MCP through one connector.
interface.longDescription: Forwards all native AFFiNE workspace MCP tools dynamically through the central Bratonien MCP server. Ordinary AFFiNE API or sync routes are only used when valid server-side AFFiNE API/session authentication already exists; the connector does not request or store a user's AFFiNE password.
defaultPrompt: Update this AFFiNE document for me.
